name: Usual Token Contract
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.97). Replaced keyword guess "oracle-manipulation".
rootCause: On May 27, 2025, Usual’s USD0++ 'Sky Vault' on Base was exploited through an arbitrage of its capped unwrap mechanism, resulting in about $42,800 in loss to protocol-controlled vault funds. No user deposits were affected, and the vault was promptly paused. A capped conversion mechanism for unwrapping USD0++ to USD0 during Sky Vault deposits created a transitory price discrepancy. This pricing edge let an attacker cycle deposits and withdrawals to repeatedly extract value from the vault.
